D01.title: Continuous complete-group book join
D01.next_action: Verify source continuity/reset handling and join every event group, including groups without prints. Preserve ties and original cursors. Validate before/during agreement against source.

D02.title: Learned native-flow histories
D02.next_action: Reconstruct per-side arrivals and expiry from complete admitted trades. Learn fast/slow/quiet windows by strategy and stage; log source event time and availability time separately. Preserve unknown side, known-empty and balanced states.

D03.title: Cancellation scope and mechanism
D03.next_action: Link actual action semantics to full-book, old-touch, new-touch and near/far scope; distinguish fill-linked reductions, cancels, reprices, reset and unknown removals. Preserve each scope as a separate branch.

D04.title: Order identity and lineage
D04.next_action: Bootstrap order ledger; track seed, partial fill, residual, refill, reprice and cancellation across complete groups; scope IDs to contract/session/reset segment.

D05.title: Morphology and learned observation scale
D05.next_action: Use each distinct completed update once for pattern state while retaining every tick attachment. Learn update-count and elapsed-time definitions separately; freeze their definitions and keep original native series.

D06.title: Recognition cohort join
D06.next_action: Verify recognition group and quotes for all candidates, not only selected cases; retain missing/late recognition and never substitute birth. Learn delays and observation-lateness handling.

D07.title: S producer/state/clock mapping
D07.next_action: Bind compact feature producer, units, lookbacks and exact input cursors; state-mask each slot independently. Recover other dates if possible without inventing observations.

D08.title: External release and delivery proof
D08.next_action: Verify declared publication against source receipt/vintage, actual availability, revisions and contract mapping. Keep static levels and between-day shifts distinct from within-window changes.

D09.title: Model input parity
D09.next_action: Reproduce original feature transformations and frozen M0/M1 parity before comparative use; new learned horizons require separate refit/version and untouched validation.

D10.title: Paper execution contract
D10.next_action: Bind exact contract, executable quote/order model, latency and fees. Log all setups and no-fill/paused/capped states without deleting opportunities. No new adapter activated.

D11.title: Horizon discovery and validation
D11.next_action: Follow HORIZON_RESEARCH.md: use complete development streams, event/time axes, nested temporal validation and untouched sessions. Do not optimize on these outcome-selected cases or report a universal winning horizon.

additive_hypotheses.name: Flow-to-price response delay
additive_hypotheses.question: Does fresh flow transmit to both quotes at different delays depending on refill/cancellation state?
additive_hypotheses.research_protocol: Keep every arrival, no-response, delayed-response and adverse-response episode. Estimate elapsed-time and complete-group response distributions, censored at known observation end. Use as timing/management information without assuming direction.
additive_hypotheses.status: new additive research hypothesis; no fitted rule or execution

additive_hypotheses.name: Displayed size versus order-count divergence
additive_hypotheses.question: Do falling lots with rising order counts, or the converse, distinguish fragmentation, resistance and later quote movement?
additive_hypotheses.research_protocol: Keep all four change-sign combinations and exact zero changes. Treat the ratio as optional derived context, with separate raw operands; resolve identities before attributing fragmentation to a mechanism.
additive_hypotheses.status: new additive research hypothesis; no fitted rule or execution

additive_hypotheses.name: Liquidity withdrawal and return
additive_hypotheses.question: Does the time and event count from actual cancellation to same-price liquidity return distinguish continuation from failed release?
additive_hypotheses.research_protocol: Track same-order versus replacement-order return and original versus new touch. Retain absent return and unresolved identity. Learn time scales; never use eventual refill to classify a live setup.
additive_hypotheses.status: new additive research hypothesis; no fitted rule or execution

additive_hypotheses.name: Trade-print movement versus quote movement
additive_hypotheses.question: Can print-side alternation explain small/brief moves while quote relocation marks a different state?
additive_hypotheses.research_protocol: Preserve every print and bid/ask path. Record previous-price returns, same-side prints, spread changes and both-quote relocation separately across all types. This is an additional explanatory and management branch, never a rule for removing bounce-like cases.
additive_hypotheses.status: new additive research hypothesis; no fitted rule or execution

additive_hypotheses.name: Information-state context and lifecycle age
additive_hypotheses.question: Do separately observed age, survival, replenishment and information inputs distinguish stalls, renewed activity or management needs?
additive_hypotheses.research_protocol: Keep all 19 S fields and each state slot; do not make available-on-Oct18 observations a four-day claim. Missing and zero-MI states remain visible. Source-clock and producer dependencies precede any live use.
additive_hypotheses.status: new additive research hypothesis; no fitted rule or execution

additive_hypotheses.name: External vintage and market-state interaction
additive_hypotheses.question: Do publication-vintage context and contract curve state change the interpretation of local flow/liquidity response?
additive_hypotheses.research_protocol: Preserve all 13 X fields, revisions and original states. Four selected days cannot isolate a day-level external effect; expand independent sessions before fitting. Separate price-derived curve context from independent external observations.
additive_hypotheses.status: new additive research hypothesis; no fitted rule or execution
